# Codebase Exploration Report

## Overview

The primary relevant project is **`claude-skills-and-agents-manager`** at `/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/`. This is an **Electron desktop application** (built with electron-vite, React, TypeScript, Zustand, TailwindCSS) that serves as a visual management GUI for Claude Code's agents, skills, plugins, commands, hooks, MCP servers, plans, and project sessions. There are also two secondary projects with related code.

---

## 1. AGENT MANAGEMENT

### Types

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/shared/types/agent.ts`**
- Defines the `Agent` interface with fields: `name`, `description`, `tools` (array of tool names), `model` (sonnet/opus/haiku/inherit), `body` (system prompt content), `source` (personal or plugin), `pluginId`, `filePath`.
- Defines `AgentFormData` for create/edit forms.
- Exports `AVAILABLE_TOOLS` (Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep, WebFetch, WebSearch, Task, TodoWrite, NotebookEdit) and `AVAILABLE_MODELS` (sonnet, opus, haiku, inherit).

### Backend Service

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/main/services/AgentService.ts`**
- `AgentService` class with methods: `list()`, `read(name)`, `write(name, data)`, `delete(name)`.
- Lists agents from `~/.claude/agents/` directory (personal agents as `.md` files).
- Also aggregates agents from installed plugins (reads from `~/.claude/plugins/csam_installed_plugins.json`).
- Uses `ParserService` to parse frontmatter-based `.md` agent files.
- Checks `settings.json` for which plugins are enabled before including their agents.

### Frontend Store

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/stores/agentStore.ts`**
- Zustand store (`useAgentStore`) with state: `items` (Agent array), `loading`, and actions `fetch()` and `deleteAgent(name)`.
- Calls `window.electronAPI.agents.list()` / `.delete()` via IPC bridge.

### Pages

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/pages/AgentsPage.tsx`**
- Grid-based listing page for all agents. Shows agent cards with name, description, source badge (personal/plugin), model badge, and tool chips.
- Includes search filtering and source filter (all/personal/plugin).
- Links to agent detail pages and "New Agent" creation.

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/pages/AgentDetailPage.tsx`**
- Full agent editor with fields for name, description, model selector, tool selector (toggle buttons), and a system prompt textarea.
- Supports creating new agents, editing personal agents, and viewing plugin agents (read-only mode with warning banner).
- Has a "Run" button that opens a `TerminalPanel` for running the agent via CLI.
- Uses `window.electronAPI.cli.runAgent(name, prompt)` to execute agents.

### Office/Project Agent Components

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/components/office/AgentList.tsx`**
- Component for listing Claude Code session "agents" within a project. Each agent has a `sessionId`, `projectDir`, `isActive` status.
- Supports batch selection, batch delete, resume session via terminal, individual delete.
- Shows active/inactive status with visual indicators (green pulse dot for active).

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/components/office/ContextViewer.tsx`**
- Renders conversation context for a selected agent session. Parses JSONL files and displays messages with role icons (user/assistant/system), timestamps, and tool call badges.

---

## 2. SKILLS MANAGEMENT

### Types

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/shared/types/skill.ts`**
- Defines `Skill` interface: `name`, `description`, `userInvocable`, `disableModelInvocation`, `body`, `source`, `pluginId`, `filePath`, `hasReference`, `hasTemplates`.

### Backend Service

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/main/services/SkillService.ts`**
- `SkillService` class with methods: `list()` (returns `{personal, plugin}`), `read(source, name)`, `write(name, body, metadata)`, `delete(name)`, `getDirectoryTree()`, `readFileContent()`, `writeFileContent()`.
- Skills are stored as directories under `~/.claude/skills/[skill-name]/SKILL.md` (with optional `reference/` and `templates/` subdirectories).
- Plugin skills can be at plugin root (`SKILL.md`) or under `skills/` subdirectory.
- Supports a directory tree view for file browsing.

### Frontend Store

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/stores/skillStore.ts`**
- Zustand store (`useSkillStore`) with state: `personal`, `plugin` arrays, `directoryTree`, and actions: `fetch()`, `createSkill()`, `updateSkill()`, `deleteSkill()`, `getShadowedSkills()`, `fetchDirectoryTree()`, `readFileContent()`, `writeFileContent()`.
- `getShadowedSkills()` identifies plugin skills that are overridden by personal skills of the same name.

### Pages

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/pages/SkillsPage.tsx`**
- Dual-view page: "Cards" view (grid of skill cards) and "Tree" view (directory tree with file preview panel).
- Skill cards show name, description, source badge, and reference/templates indicators.
- Tree view shows a file explorer with rendered Markdown preview.
- Supports search filtering and shadowed skill detection (orange border warning).

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/pages/SkillDetailPage.tsx`**
- Full skill detail/editor page with: Markdown rendered body, reference/template file sidebar tree, inline file editing with Monaco editor, delete confirmation dialog.
- Has a "Fork to Personal" button for plugin skills and a "Test" button with terminal panel for personal skills.
- Plugin skills are read-only; personal skills are editable.

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/pages/SkillNewPage.tsx`**
- Page for creating new skills (not fully read but referenced in routes).

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/pages/SkillsTreePage.tsx`**
- Standalone tree view page for skills directory browsing.

### Components

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/components/skills/SkillEditor.tsx`**
- Form component for editing skill metadata and body content.

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/components/skills/SkillFileTree.tsx`**
- Tree component for browsing reference and template files within a skill.

---

## 3. PROJECT / WORKSPACE MANAGEMENT

### Backend Services

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/main/services/ProjectDiscoveryService.ts`**
- Discovers Claude Code projects by scanning `~/.claude/projects/` directory.
- Decodes encoded directory names (path separators replaced with dashes) back to real paths.
- Detects running Claude Code processes via `ps` + `lsof` to determine active sessions.
- Returns `ProjectInfo[]` with: `projectDir`, `projectName`, `agentCount`, `activeCount`, `lastActivity`, `sessions[]`.
- Limits to 20 most recent sessions per project, sorted by activity.

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/main/services/PixelOfficeService.ts`**
- Manages Claude Code sessions per project. Methods: `getAgentsByProject()`, `getAgentContext()`, `joinTerminal()`, `deleteAgent()`, `deleteAgents()`, `deleteProject()`.
- Parses JSONL session files to extract conversation messages with roles, text content, and tool calls.
- `joinTerminal()` opens a new terminal window (using `osascript` on macOS) to resume a Claude Code session.

### Pages

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/pages/ProjectsListPage.tsx`**
- Lists all discovered Claude Code projects in a grid of `ProjectCard` components.
- Supports deleting all sessions for a project.
- Called "Office" in the sidebar navigation.

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/pages/ProjectDetailPage.tsx`**
- Split-pane layout: left panel shows `AgentList` (session list), right panel shows `ContextViewer` (conversation history).
- Header shows project name, path, "Open Terminal" button, and refresh button.
- Supports deleting individual sessions and batch deleting sessions.

### Components

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/components/office/ProjectCard.tsx`**
- Card component displaying project name, path, session count, active count (with pulsing green dot), and relative time since last activity.
- Click navigates to project detail; has delete button.

---

## 4. MANAGEMENT PANELS, SIDEBAR, AND ADMIN INTERFACES

### Sidebar Navigation

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx`**
- Fixed left sidebar (w-64) with navigation items: Dashboard, Agents, Skills, Plugins, Commands, Hooks, MCP, Marketplace, Office, Plans, Settings.
- Uses lucide-react icons. Has active state highlighting. Footer with version and theme toggle.

### App Shell

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/components/layout/AppShell.tsx`**
- Layout wrapper with fixed sidebar and scrollable main content area. Uses React Router `<Outlet />`.

### Command Palette / Search

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/components/shared/SearchCommand.tsx`**
- Cmd+K triggered command palette that searches across agents, skills, plugins, and commands.
- Shows results grouped by type with icons. Keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Enter, Escape).

### Dashboard

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/pages/DashboardPage.tsx`**
- Overview page with: quick action buttons (New Agent, New Skill, Marketplace, Settings), stats grid (counts for agents, skills, plugins, commands, hooks, MCP servers), and recent personal agents/skills lists.
- Aggregates data from all six stores (agent, skill, plugin, command, hook, mcp).

### Plugins Management

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/pages/PluginsPage.tsx`**
- Lists installed plugins with toggle switches (enable/disable), uninstall button, version info, and detail navigation.

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/pages/PluginDetailPage.tsx`**
- Detail page for a single plugin.

### Marketplace

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/pages/MarketplacePage.tsx`**
- Browse and install plugins from marketplace sources. Has install dialog, plugin detail view, and marketplace list.

### Plans Management

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/pages/PlansPage.tsx`**
- Lists plan files from `~/.claude/plans/`. Split-pane with list and preview. Supports search, batch delete, edit with textarea, fullscreen preview mode, and Markdown rendering.

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/main/services/PlanService.ts`**
- Backend service for plan CRUD: `listPlans()`, `readPlan()`, `writePlan()`, `deletePlan()`, `batchDeletePlans()`.

### Other Management Pages

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/pages/CommandsPage.tsx`** / **`CommandDetailPage.tsx`**
- Browse and view plugin-provided slash commands.

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/pages/HooksPage.tsx`**
- Lists event hooks from plugins (SessionStart, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, etc.).

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/pages/MCPPage.tsx`**
- Manages MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers. Lists active servers and templates.

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/pages/SettingsPage.tsx`**
- Application settings management.

### IPC Architecture

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/shared/ipc-channels.ts`**
- Defines all IPC channel names organized by domain: AGENTS, SKILLS, PLUGINS, COMMANDS, HOOKS, MCP, SETTINGS, MARKETPLACE, CLI, OFFICE, PLANS.

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/main/ipc/registerHandlers.ts`**
- Registers all Electron IPC handlers mapping channels to service methods.
- Sets up file system watcher (chokidar) on `~/.claude/agents/`, `~/.claude/skills/`, `~/.claude/plugins/` to notify renderer of changes.

### Constants

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/shared/constants.ts`**
- Defines all file system paths: `CLAUDE_DIR` (~/.claude), `AGENTS_DIR`, `SKILLS_DIR`, `PLUGINS_DIR`, `INSTALLED_PLUGINS_FILE`, `SETTINGS_FILE`, `CLAUDE_JSON_FILE`, and marketplace-related paths.

### Routing

**`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/claude-skills-and-agents-manager/src/renderer/App.tsx`**
- React Router setup with HashRouter. Routes:
  - `/` - Dashboard
  - `/agents`, `/agents/:name` - Agent list and detail
  - `/skills`, `/skills/new`, `/skills/tree`, `/skills/:source/:name` - Skill pages
  - `/plugins`, `/plugins/:id` - Plugin pages
  - `/commands`, `/commands/:pluginId/:name` - Command pages
  - `/hooks` - Hooks page
  - `/mcp` - MCP page
  - `/marketplace` - Marketplace
  - `/settings` - Settings
  - `/office`, `/office/project/:projectDir` - Project/Office pages
  - `/plans` - Plans page

---

## 5. SECONDARY PROJECTS

### general-agent-nextjs-main

**Location**: `/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/general-agent-nextjs-main/`

A Next.js 16 application integrating the Claude Agent SDK (`@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk`) with a three-panel layout:

- **`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/general-agent-nextjs-main/app/types/agent.ts`** - Comprehensive SDK message type definitions (SDKAssistantMessage, SDKUserMessage, SDKResultMessage, SDKStatusMessage, SDKSystemMessage, etc.) and `AgentQueryRequest` interface.
- **`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/general-agent-nextjs-main/app/services/agentService.ts`** - Frontend service that calls `/api/agent` endpoint and returns a ReadableStream reader.
- **`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/general-agent-nextjs-main/app/hooks/useAgentChat.ts`** - Hook for streaming agent chat with NDJSON parsing.
- **`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/general-agent-nextjs-main/app/hooks/useAgentConfig.ts`** - Hook for persisting agent config (model, cwd, allowedTools, permissionMode, systemPrompt) to localStorage.
- **`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/general-agent-nextjs-main/app/api/agent/route.ts`** - API route that calls `query()` from Claude Agent SDK with ReadableStream for streaming NDJSON responses.
- **`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/general-agent-nextjs-main/app/components/AgentChat/`** - Chat UI components (index, MessageList, ChatInput, SDKMessageCard, MessageItem).
- **`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/general-agent-nextjs-main/app/components/ConfigPanel/`** - Configuration panel (index, ConfigForm).
- **`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/general-agent-nextjs-main/app/components/FileManager/`** - File upload/management (FileList, FileUploadZone, index).

### kbar-demo

**Location**: `/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/kbar-demo/`

- **`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/kbar-demo/src/App.tsx`** - Demo of the `kbar` command palette library (React, Vite). Defines actions for navigation, theme switching, and sidebar toggling. Shows the `Cmd+K` command palette pattern.

### Slack Clone

**Location**: `/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/Slack/`

- **`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/Slack/src/components/DashboardLayout.tsx`** - Full dashboard layout with resizable left sidebar (channels + DMs), user info, search, mark-all-as-read, and main content area.
- **`/Users/yangsmac/Desktop/Slack/src/components/ThreadPanel.tsx`** - Resizable right-side panel for thread replies with drag handling and ESC-to-close.
- The Slack project is a full-featured messaging app clone with channels, DMs, threads, search, file uploads, notifications, MCP integration, and WebSocket support.

---

## Summary of Key Architectural Patterns

1. **Electron + React + Zustand + TailwindCSS** (main manager app)
2. **IPC Bridge Pattern**: Main process services (AgentService, SkillService, etc.) exposed to renderer via `ipcMain.handle()` / `window.electronAPI.*`
3. **File-System Based Storage**: All data (agents, skills, plugins, plans) stored as files in `~/.claude/` directory tree
4. **Frontmatter Parsing**: Agent and skill `.md` files use YAML frontmatter (parsed with `gray-matter`)
5. **File Watching**: Chokidar watches `~/.claude/` directories and notifies the UI of changes
6. **Command Palette**: Cmd+K search across all entity types
7. **Dual Source Model**: Everything supports both "personal" (user-created) and "plugin" (installed from marketplace) sources
